result.title: ThetreStageAI: Multi-View Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Structured Bengali Theatre Production Planning
result.comment: 6 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the 12th IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Technologies and Engineering (IEEE iCOSTE 2026), Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, November 1-3, 2026
result.summary: Staging a theatre performance requires coordinating dialogue, actor movement, stage directions, lighting focus, cue timing, and equipment constraints within the same production plan. This work presents ThetreStageAI, a retrieval augmented framework for structured Bengali theatre production planning. Rather than retrieving from one mixed corpus, the system maintains separate scene, actor-blocking, and lighting views. Bengali text is embedded with BGE-M3 and indexed in view-specific Qdrant collections. Retrieved references are combined with a production brief and passed to Gemini, which generates schema-constrained JSON containing characters, scenes, dialogue, stage directions, blocking, lighting, and optional sound cues. Structural and semantic checks are applied before acceptance, with at most one constrained repair attempt. We also construct a human-guided, LLM-assisted synthetic dataset of 500 short Bengali theatre records that expands to 1,500 retrieval documents. Dataset diagnostics confirm consistent identifiers and valid lighting fields while also revealing substantial dialogue repetition. A paired camera-ready evaluation compares single-combined and full multi-view retrieval under matched settings. The source code, dataset, and evaluation materials are publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 ThetreStageAI，一个面向孟加拉语戏剧排演规划的多视图检索增强生成框架：分别维护场景、走位与灯光三套检索库，将检索结果与创作简报交给 Gemini 生成 schema 约束的 JSON 计划，并做结构与语义校验和一次受限修复。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于特定语种文本创作规划的常规 RAG 应用，未见内部状态、视觉证据或推理决策机制，多视图检索与约束校验只是通用 IR 与解码约束手段，与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系。
